verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents an HTTP API for sending data from your backend (jitsu-docs-2), and it accepts Segment webhook traffic server-to-server (jitsu-docs-6). Delivery guarantees are backed by Kafka buffering during warehouse outages, deduplication of resent data, and a dead-letter queue with replay (jitsu-docs-8, jitsu-docs-9, jitsu-docs-16). missing for 10: documented authentication for the ingestion endpoint (the token and OAuth evidence covers user, management and MCP access, not event ingestion), in-depth ingestion API reference details, independent or hands-on corroboration of server-side ingestion and delivery guarantees.
